title: PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare triplicate PCR with mastermix
steps.instruction: Set up a custom PCR preparation on each DNA sample in triplicate using the pre‑created mastermix.

steps.title: Enter sample and oligo counts
steps.instruction: Input the number of DNA samples and Oligo standards (maximum 30 of each) into the protocol interface.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the OT (Opentrons) App.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles if needed).

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
